content: Human-labeling session — econ-replace-dead-harvester:medium seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a worker-replacement drill with a tighter throughput bar. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), Ore Refinery (proc), Allied Barracks (tent), War Factory (weap — produces vehicles including harvesters), three harvesters (harv, unarmed ore-collector trucks) on two near ore patches, and two heavy tanks (3tnk) on Defend stance, with $1100 in the bank. An enemy Mammoth tank (4tnk) attacks from the east and kills ONE harvester before your defenders wipe it. Within about 60 turns, reach economy value $2500 (cash plus stored ore), have at least three harvesters alive, and keep your Refinery standing.
